_comment: Technique 4: redefining a shipped scene id. 'work.librarian.current_task.evergreen' is
the one catalog that sorts its files by ResourceLocation before folding them, so
'sample_retune' (s) is read after 'mcaconversations' (m) and this definition wins, every time,
on every install. That is a namespace-sort-order guarantee, not a pack-priority one.
The change: the shipped scene is an always-available filler at base_priority 6 with no
cooldown. This one keeps the same route but makes the librarian mention their current task
less often - a real cooldown, a weekly cap, and a lean toward villagers who value precision.
Every field of the shipped scene is restated: a redefinition replaces, it does not merge.
